fix_description: The search term, replace term, and source filename are compared in mixed Unicode encodings, so an NFD (decomposed) character or a non-breaking space (U+00A0) in the filename never matches an NFC/normal-space search term. Add/route all three strings through a SanitizeAndNormalize() helper that replaces NBSP with a regular space and applies NormalizeString(NormalizationC, ...) to precompose to NFC, invoked consistently in PutSearchTerm, PutReplaceTerm, and Replace before matching. Add coverage for NFD/NBSP cases in unittests/CommonRegExTests.h so both the std::regex and boost::regex engines are validated.
